Mengembalikan catatan ke keadaan sebelum: Returns the note to the state before the last change.
Ketuk tombol, atau tekan Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z d: Tap the button, or press Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on Mac).
Ketikan beruntun dihitung satu langkah —: A run of typing counts as one step — pausing half a second marks a new step. History keeps 100 steps and resets when you switch notes.
Mengembalikan perubahan yang barusan dib: Restores the change you just undid.
Ketuk tombol, atau tekan Ctrl+Shift+Z /: Tap the button, or press Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y.
Kalau kamu mengetik sesuatu yang baru se: If you type something new after undoing, the redo path is broken and can't be used again.
Membuka daftar jenis blok: heading, daft: Opens the list of block types: heading, list, to-do, quote, code, divider, image.
Ketuk tombol, atau ketik \"/\" di awal b: Tap the button, or type "/" at the start of a line. Keep typing to filter.
Panah atas/bawah untuk memilih, Enter un: Arrow up/down to choose, Enter to apply, Esc to cancel. The "/" character is removed when a block is picked.
Menebalkan teks untuk menandai bagian pe: Makes text bold to mark important parts.
Blok teks lalu ketuk, atau ketuk dulu la: Select text and tap, or tap first and start typing.
Mengetik **teks** juga langsung menebalk: Typing **text** bolds it too. Tap again to turn it off — it can combine with italics.
Memiringkan teks, biasanya untuk istilah: Slants text, usually for foreign terms or gentle emphasis.
Blok teks lalu pilih, atau nyalakan dulu: Select text first, or turn it on and start typing.
Di web, garis bawah biasanya berarti tau: On the web, underlines usually mean links — use sparingly to avoid confusion.
Memberi latar berwarna pada teks, sepert: Adds a colored background to text, like a highlighter.
Select text and pick this option.
Sintaks markdown-nya ==teks==. Berguna m: The markdown syntax is ==text==. Handy for flagging parts to reread.
Strikes through text without deleting it.
Sintaks markdown-nya ~~teks~~. Cocok unt: The markdown syntax is ~~text~~. Good for marking something outdated that should stay visible.
Menandai potongan kode pendek di tengah: Marks a short code snippet in the middle of a sentence with a monospace font.
The markdown syntax is `text` (backtick). Unlike a code block, which takes a whole line.
Merontokkan semua format pada teks: teba: Strips all formatting from text: bold, italic, highlight, strikethrough, code.
Blok teks lalu pilih. Tanpa memblok apa: Select text and pick it. With no selection, the whole block becomes a plain paragraph.
Tanpa seleksi, indent dan checkbox to-do: Without a selection, indents and to-do checkboxes are cleared too. Useful when formatting feels stuck.
Turns the block back into a plain paragraph.
Taruh kursor di blok mana pun lalu pilih: Place the cursor in any block and pick it.
Menekan Backspace di awal blok berformat: Pressing Backspace at the start of a formatted block also turns it back into a paragraph.
Judul terbesar, untuk bagian utama catat: The largest heading, for the note's main sections.
Taruh kursor di blok lalu pilih, atau ke: Place the cursor in a block and pick it, or type "# " at the start of a line.
Menekan Enter di akhir heading otomatis: Pressing Enter at the end of a heading starts a plain paragraph, not another heading.
Ketik \"## \" di awal baris, atau pilih: Type "## " at the start of a line, or pick it from this menu.
Memakai huruf serif seperti H1, tapi leb: Uses a serif font like H1, but smaller.
Judul tingkat ketiga, untuk rincian di d: Third-level heading, for details within a subsection.
Ketik \"### \" di awal baris, atau pilih: Type "### " at the start of a line, or pick it from this menu.
Sengaja memakai huruf sans-serif tebal s: Deliberately uses a bold sans-serif font so it stands apart from H1 and H2.
Menandai teks sebagai kutipan, dengan ga: Marks text as a quote, with a line on the left side.
Ketik \"> \" di awal baris, atau pilih d: Type "> " at the start of a line, or pick it from this menu.
Untuk kotak berwarna dengan label, pakai: For a colored box with a label, use a Callout.
Blok monospace untuk kode beberapa baris: A monospace block for multi-line code. Spaces and line breaks are kept as-is.
Ketik \"```\" lalu Enter, atau pilih dar: Type "```" then Enter, or pick it from this menu.
Markdown otomatis tidak berlaku di dalam: Automatic markdown doesn't apply inside — typing **text** here stays as-is.
Kotak penekanan berwarna dengan label, u: A colored callout box with a label, for important notes or warnings.
Pilih menu ini, lalu tentukan jenisnya:: Pick this menu, then choose the kind: Info, Tip, Warning, or Danger.
Bisa juga diketik langsung: \"> [!tip] \: You can also type it directly: "> [!tip] ". Each kind has its own color.
Daftar bertitik untuk butir yang urutann: A bulleted list for items whose order doesn't matter.
Ketik \"- \" di awal baris, atau pilih d: Type "- " at the start of a line, or pick it from this menu.
Enter membuat butir baru. Enter pada but: Enter makes a new item. Enter on an empty item exits the list.
Daftar bernomor untuk langkah atau uruta: A numbered list for steps or order that matters.
Ketik \"1. \" di awal baris, atau pilih: Type "1. " at the start of a line, or pick it from this menu.
Nomor dihitung ulang otomatis. Menyisipk: Numbers renumber automatically. Inserting or removing an item in the middle keeps the order correct, and a list broken by another paragraph restarts at 1.
Daftar centang untuk tugas yang bisa dit: A checklist for tasks you can mark done.
Ketik \"- [ ] \" di awal baris, atau pil: Type "- [ ] " at the start of a line, or pick it from this menu. Tap the circle to check it.
Teks yang sudah dicentang otomatis dicor: Checked text is automatically struck through and dimmed.
Links to another note inside Hara.
Pilih menu ini lalu pilih catatan tujuan: Pick this menu and choose the target note, or type [[ to bring up the list.
Menautkan ke nama yang belum ada catatan: Linking to a name that has no note yet appears dashed — tap it to create it.
Links text to a web address.
Blok teks lalu ketuk. Isi alamatnya, tek: Select text and tap. Fill in the address; the visible text fills in automatically.
Alamat dirapikan sendiri: \"hara.app\" j: Addresses tidy themselves: "hara.app" becomes https://, and "a@b.com" becomes mailto:. Put the cursor inside a link to edit or remove it.
Menyisipkan gambar dari perangkat ke dal: Inserts an image from your device into the note.
Pilih menu ini lalu pilih berkasnya. Ara: Pick this menu and choose the file. Point at the image to reveal the delete button.
Foto besar dikecilkan otomatis ke maksim: Large photos are automatically resized to 1600 px max to save space. Images are stored separately on the device, not inside the note text, so notes stay light.
Menandai catatan dengan kata kunci untuk: Labels the note with keywords for grouping.
Pilih menu ini, atau ketik # diikuti nam: Pick this menu, or type # followed by the tag name.
Tag bisa bersarang dengan garis miring,: Tags can nest with slashes, e.g. #proyek/hara.
Memberi id pada satu blok supaya bisa di: Gives a block an id so it can be referenced from other notes.
Taruh kursor di blok lalu pilih. Rujukan: Place the cursor in a block and pick it. The reference is copied to the clipboard right away.
Hasilnya berbentuk [[Judul#^a3f2]]. Pili: The result looks like [[Judul#^a3f2]]. Pick again to remove the marker. Ids are guaranteed unique across all notes.
Garis mendatar untuk memisahkan bagian c: A horizontal line to separate sections of the note.
Pilih menu ini. Blok teks baru otomatis: Pick this menu. A new text block is created right after it.
Garisnya bukan teks, jadi tidak ikut ter: The line isn't text, so it doesn't count toward the letter count.
Taruh kursor di tempat yang diinginkan l: Place the cursor where you want it and pick.
Formatnya bahasa Indonesia lengkap denga: Uses the full format with the weekday in the current language, e.g. "Sunday, September 6, 2026".
Menggeser blok ke kanan untuk membuat ti: Shifts the block right to create levels.
Taruh kursor di blok lalu pilih, atau te: Place the cursor in a block and pick it, or press Tab.
Sekali geser 24 piksel dan bisa ditumpuk: Each shift is 24 pixels and they stack. Useful for nested lists.
Shifts the block back to the left.
Taruh kursor di blok lalu pilih, atau te: Place the cursor in a block and pick it, or press Shift+Tab.
Berhenti sendiri saat blok sudah rata ki: Stops on its own once the block is flush left.
Menukar posisi blok dengan blok di atasn: Swaps the block with the one above it.
Place the cursor in a block and pick it.
Kursor ikut berpindah bersama bloknya, j: The cursor moves with the block, so you can press repeatedly to move it far.
Menukar posisi blok dengan blok di bawah: Swaps the block with the one below it.
Jauh lebih ringkas daripada seleksi–poto: Far neater than select–cut–paste, especially on touch screens.
Mewarnai teks. Pilih dari strip warna (h: Colors text. Pick from the color strip (black to white, then common colors), the color wheel, or type your own code — e.g. #3b82f6, rgb(59,130,246), hsl(220,100%,50%). With no text selected, the color applies to what you type next. "Default" returns to the theme color.
Mengganti jenis huruf. Pilihan berlaku u: Changes the font. The choice applies to text you type next; select text first to restyle existing writing. Fonts missing from your device are marked and won't look different.
Mengubah peran satu blok: judul, kutipan: Changes one block's role: heading, quote, code, or callout. Applies to the whole block containing the cursor.
Memberi penanda pada potongan teks yang: Marks the selected text span. Marks can stack, and are removed by selecting again.
Mengubah blok jadi daftar. Enter membuat: Turns the block into a list. Enter adds an item; Enter on an empty item exits the list.
Menambahkan sesuatu yang baru di posisi: Adds something new at the cursor position.
